lessonTitle: Pain Assessment: Believing the Story Behind the Score
description: Scales, faces and words — measuring what can't be seen and taking it seriously.

lessonTitle: Wound Care Principles: Protecting the Body's Barrier
description: How wounds heal and how you help — clean, protect, observe, and never disturb what's working.
Applying the basics you learned — hands, linen, sharps and equipment in real patient contact.

lessonTitle: Patient Observation: The Nurse's Sixth Sense
description: How often, what to look for and how to record it — the rhythm of safe observation.

lessonTitle: Spotting the Patient Who Is Getting Worse
description: Early deterioration whispers — learn the changes that demand action before they shout.
Skin, mucous membranes and chemicals — the remarkable walls that stop most invaders daily.
White cells, inflammation and antibodies — the fast and slow armies that fight infection.
From vaccination to mother-to-baby antibodies — the two ways protection is gained and passed on.
The right container, the right technique, the right time — results are only as good as samples.

lessonTitle: Common Laboratory Tests: Stains, Cultures and More
description: What actually happens to your swab — the lab tests that confirm what you suspect.
Reading reports wisely — growth, sensitivity and the art of matching results to the patient.
How antibiotics work, why they sometimes stop working, and what that means for your patients.
The infections hospitals themselves cause — prevention as a daily professional obligation.
